_source: SZS C5 Konstruktionstabellen, revision 2018, reprinted 2021: ExternalFiles/000-Normes/SZS-C5-2021.pdf (the engineer's copy is 301-Normes/SZS-C5-2018.pdf). The PDF is a scan: every number was read off a render of its page (220 and 330 dpi) and held three ways -- against the page's OCR text, against the section's own mechanics (i = sqrt(I/A), W_el = I/(h/2), A from h, b, t_w, t_f, r), and against the «Hilfstabelle Stahl-Profile» of the steel check templates (tests/fixtures/steel-reference-profiles.json); wherever they disagreed the page was read again at 330-400 dpi and the page wins. Values are as printed, each column's factor under its head (×10⁶, ×10³) stated in `columns`; the reader converts them into plain mm units. This file: Vierkantstäbe / Carrés, printed p. 55 (PDF 59), «Statische Werte / Valeurs statiques» and «Profilmasse / Dimensions de la section».
_note: The last row is 500 in the table's left column and 480 in its right one; A = 250 000 mm² = 500², so 500 is kept.
